newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian dollar closes slightly weaker.
newsitem.headline: Canadian dollar closes slightly weaker.

text.p: * Canada's dollar closed slightly weaker Monday at C$1.3445 (US$0.7438) from Friday's close at C$1.3449 (US$0.7436) after a day of busy trading within a tight range, dealers said. * They said the currency market was stable despite a Bank of Canada rate cut on Monday morning, because the market had already discounted the cut.
The market would likely stick to a tight range until the United States released new real GDP statistics on Wednesday and Canada reported its monthly GDP data on Thursday, said traders.
On the crosses, the Canadian dollar slipped to 1.1288 marks from Friday's close of 1.1299 marks, but rose to 84.90 yen from 84.27 yen.
